title: Listen and Do

serves.summary: The child hears a spoken instruction with one, two or three steps once and then does the steps in order in a picture (put the hat on the dog, open the box and then put the ball in, put the star in the small red cup), which shows listening to and following multi-step oral directions with position and describing words.

request.topic: Listening to and following spoken directions with two steps
request.objective: Listen to a two-step instruction once, then do both actions in the order given, on the right objects. (LA003-01-A, LA005-04-C)

problems.ask: Listen: put the hat on the dog.
problems.goal: The hat on the dog. The hat on another animal (any animal will do) is the miss.

doneSoFar: put the hat on the dog
put the hat on the cat

problems.ask: Listen: put the apple in the basket, then put the ball on the chair.
problems.goal: Apple to the basket, then ball to the chair. Only the ball to the chair (the last thing heard) is the miss.

doneSoFar: put the apple in the basket
put the ball in the chair
put the ball in the chair

problems.ask: Listen: open the box, then put the ball in the box.
problems.goal: Box opened, then the ball in it. The ball first (the closed box sends it back) and then the box opened is the miss.

doneSoFar: put the ball in the box

problems.ask: Listen: put the star in the small red cup, then put the moon in the big blue cup.
problems.goal: Star in the small red cup, then moon in the big blue cup. The star in the big red cup (any red cup) is the miss.

doneSoFar: put the star in the small red cup
put the moon in the big blue cup
put the star in the big red cup
put the moon in the big blue cup

problems.ask: Listen: open the box, put the teddy bear in it, then put the hat on the cat.
problems.goal: Box opened, bear in the box, hat on the cat, in that order. Hat on the cat first, then the box and the bear, is the miss.

doneSoFar: put the teddy bear in the box
put the hat on the cat
put the hat on the cat
put the teddy bear in the box
